name: Thumper drive Mk I
description: A fighter drive with a nozzle wider than the pilot's shoulders.

name: Thumper drive Mk II
description: Same drive, more fuel pushed through it. Louder.

name: Thumper drive Mk III
description: Runs past its rated heat and has the scorch marks to show it.

name: Stomper drive Mk I
description: Bolted-on twin-chamber thruster. It outweighs the cabin it pushes.

name: Stomper drive Mk II
description: Retuned with a bigger injector. Shakes the rivets in the neighbouring hull plates.

name: Stomper drive Mk III
description: Glows orange at the nozzle rim after a long burn. Standing behind it is a bad idea.

name: Ironlung drive Mk I
description: A ground-built hauler engine, big enough to move a warehouse.

name: Ironlung drive Mk II
description: Larger turbopump and a thicker casing. Orc fitters say it purrs. It does not.

name: Ironlung drive Mk III
description: Pushes hard enough that crews strap cargo down twice.

name: Rumbler drive Mk I
description: A cast heavy-world engine. It was designed for 4 g and takes 3 as a gentle shove.

name: Rumbler drive Mk II
description: The Mk II casting adds a second injector ring and a lot of noise.

name: Rumbler drive Mk III
description: Burns bright and heavy. The exhaust plume can be seen from the next system, or so the yard claims.

name: Mountain drive Mk I
description: The largest drive the yards pour. It takes a crane and several arguments to fit.

name: Mountain drive Mk II
description: Thicker walls, more thrust, same shouting from the engine room.

name: Mountain drive Mk III
description: The yard's loudest engine. Fitted by people who have stopped asking whether it is too much.

name: Furnace plant Mk I
description: Six pips from a furnace that never quite cools. Warm to the touch from across the cabin.

name: Furnace plant Mk II
description: A tougher reactor with a bigger capacitor. Sheds the extra heat out of a vent that glows.

name: Furnace plant Mk III
description: Run hot by design. Orc engineers say the vent colour tells you when to worry.

name: Stove plant Mk I
description: A squat reactor with a heavy radiator block. Looks like a stove, behaves like one.

name: Stove plant Mk II
description: Larger capacitor bank, same blunt radiators.

name: Stove plant Mk III
description: Gets the most from its fuel and the least from its cooling. Good for one long fight.

name: Boiler plant Mk I
description: Mid-size reactor that runs well above its rating. The rating is a suggestion.

name: Boiler plant Mk II
description: Reinforced coils keep the extra load from cracking the housing.

name: Boiler plant Mk III
description: Uncomfortably warm in the engine room. Weapon crews like the output.

name: Foundry plant Mk I
description: A slab of a reactor fed by a hand-welded coolant loop.

name: Foundry plant Mk II
description: Added capacitor rings, added noise.

name: Foundry plant Mk III
description: Runs flat out and rarely complains. Neither does the crew, to its face.

name: Forge plant Mk I
description: The biggest plant the yards make. Feeds a gun deck without stalling.

name: Forge plant Mk II
description: The Mk II shows fewer leaks than the first batch.

name: Forge plant Mk III
description: Eats fuel and gives back power in a rush. The radiator fins are scorched at the tips.

name: Buckler screen Mk I
description: A thin plate of field and a lot of hope. Orc pilots tend to dodge instead.

name: Buckler screen Mk II
description: Slightly thicker. Still gives way to the first good hit.

name: Buckler screen Mk III
description: Takes a few hits before it gives up, which is more than the Mk I managed.

name: Hide screen Mk I
description: Stretched across a bigger hull than it should be.

name: Hide screen Mk II
description: A second emitter bolted next to the first.

name: Hide screen Mk III
description: Holds a short fight and flickers when it is over.

name: Slab screen Mk I
description: Mid-size screen. Orc crews call it a good place to put a sticker.

name: Slab screen Mk II
description: Better capacity, same temper.

name: Slab screen Mk III
description: Recharges quickly once it is allowed to. Nobody lets it.

name: Wall screen Mk I
description: A heavy emitter that sags at the edges.

name: Wall screen Mk II
description: More capacity, but the edge sag remains.

name: Wall screen Mk III
description: Gets the job done for gunships that do not plan to be hit.

name: Bulwark screen Mk I
description: A big, thin screen over a very big ship.

name: Bulwark screen Mk II
description: The Mk II holds up a little longer.

name: Bulwark screen Mk III
description: The best the yards can offer. Dwarves still smile politely at the figures.

name: Squint sensors Mk I
description: A cracked-lens targeting scope. Sees what it needs to hit.

name: Squint sensors Mk II
description: Cleaner optics and a longer reach.

name: Squint sensors Mk III
description: The lens finally has no cracks. Pilots find this suspicious.

name: Stare sensors Mk I
description: A scope with an antenna array pulled from a mining rig.

name: Stare sensors Mk II
description: Added a second dish. Lopsided, but it works.

name: Stare sensors Mk III
description: Reaches further and picks up more clutter. The crew learns to ignore it.

name: Glare sensors Mk I
description: A big dish on a sturdy mast. Hard to knock off.

name: Glare sensors Mk II
description: Longer range, same mast.

name: Glare sensors Mk III
description: Sees a long way. Interpreting what it sees is left to the crew.

name: Scrap rack
description: A bolted-on rack with chain tie-downs. Holds 8 tonnes if the lid shuts.

name: Slab rack
description: A wider rack with a welded frame and a proper door.

name: Cage rack
description: A cargo cage built to survive being dropped.

name: Big cage rack
description: A heavy hold on a reinforced frame.

name: Warehouse rack
description: A giant cage-hold. Loading it takes shouting.

name: Thudgun Mk I
description: A heavy autocannon that fires solid slugs in loud bursts.

name: Thudgun Mk II
description: Longer barrel and a stronger breech.

name: Thudgun Mk III
description: The recoil is felt through the whole cabin. The crew approves.

name: Heavy Thudgun Mk I
description: Twin-mounted for bigger hulls. A heavy autocannon that fires solid slugs in loud bursts.

name: Heavy Thudgun Mk II
description: Twin-mounted for bigger hulls. Longer barrel and a stronger breech.

name: Heavy Thudgun Mk III
description: Twin-mounted for bigger hulls. The recoil is felt through the whole cabin. The crew approves.

name: Siege Thudgun Mk I
description: A turret-sized version. A heavy autocannon that fires solid slugs in loud bursts.

name: Siege Thudgun Mk II
description: A turret-sized version. Longer barrel and a stronger breech.

name: Siege Thudgun Mk III
description: A turret-sized version. The recoil is felt through the whole cabin. The crew approves.

name: Spitter Mk I
description: A short-range scattergun. Best used at spitting distance.

name: Spitter Mk II
description: More chambers, more spread.

name: Spitter Mk III
description: Fires faster and rattles the mounting. Shredder at close range.

name: Heavy Spitter Mk I
description: Twin-mounted for bigger hulls. A short-range scattergun. Best used at spitting distance.

name: Heavy Spitter Mk II
description: Twin-mounted for bigger hulls. More chambers, more spread.

name: Heavy Spitter Mk III
description: Twin-mounted for bigger hulls. Fires faster and rattles the mounting. Shredder at close range.

name: Siege Spitter Mk I
description: A turret-sized version. A short-range scattergun. Best used at spitting distance.

name: Siege Spitter Mk II
description: A turret-sized version. More chambers, more spread.

name: Siege Spitter Mk III
description: A turret-sized version. Fires faster and rattles the mounting. Shredder at close range.

name: Bonker Mk I
description: A slow slug thrower that hits like a dropped anvil.

name: Bonker Mk II
description: Heavier slug and a reinforced barrel.

name: Bonker Mk III
description: Slow and brutal. Hits an expected target at the expected time.

name: Heavy Bonker Mk I
description: Twin-mounted for bigger hulls. A slow slug thrower that hits like a dropped anvil.

name: Heavy Bonker Mk II
description: Twin-mounted for bigger hulls. Heavier slug and a reinforced barrel.

name: Heavy Bonker Mk III
description: Twin-mounted for bigger hulls. Slow and brutal. Hits an expected target at the expected time.

name: Siege Bonker Mk I
description: A turret-sized version. A slow slug thrower that hits like a dropped anvil.

name: Siege Bonker Mk II
description: A turret-sized version. Heavier slug and a reinforced barrel.

name: Siege Bonker Mk III
description: A turret-sized version. Slow and brutal. Hits an expected target at the expected time.

name: Ram plate
description: A slab of armour plate welded to the nose. Reduces damage from collisions and head-on impacts.

name: Burner tank
description: A tank of raw fuel dumped straight into the nozzles. Gives a short burst of extra speed.

name: Hammer kit
description: A crate of hammers, clamps and a welding set. Repairs hull damage in flight, loudly.

name: Bolt-on armour
description: Scrap plate bolted wherever it fits. Adds hull points and a lot of mass.
